concepts.title: Relational Model
concepts.description: Data modeled as relations (tables) with tuples and attributes.

concepts.title: Tables
concepts.description: Named relations storing rows with a defined schema.

concepts.title: SELECT Queries
concepts.description: Retrieving and projecting rows from relational tables.

concepts.title: Joins
concepts.description: Combining rows from multiple tables based on related columns.

concepts.title: SQL
concepts.description: Standard language for defining and querying relational databases.

concepts.title: Disk Storage
concepts.description: How database pages and files are laid out on persistent storage.

concepts.title: B-Trees
concepts.description: Balanced tree index structures efficient for range and equality lookups.

concepts.title: Indexes
concepts.description: Auxiliary structures that accelerate lookups and sorting.

concepts.title: Query Planning
concepts.description: Choosing an efficient execution plan for a declarative query.

concepts.title: Database Indexing
concepts.description: Designing and using indexes to improve query performance.

concepts.title: Replication
concepts.description: Copying data across nodes for availability and locality.

concepts.title: Partitioning
concepts.description: Splitting data across shards or partitions by a key.

concepts.title: Consensus
concepts.description: Agreeing on a single value or log among distributed nodes.

concepts.title: Consistency Models
concepts.description: Guarantees about visibility and ordering of reads and writes.

concepts.title: Distributed Databases
concepts.description: Databases spanning multiple nodes with replication and partitioning.

concepts.title: Relations
concepts.description: Mathematical/table relations used as the unit of schema design.

concepts.title: Functional Dependencies
concepts.description: Constraints where attribute sets determine other attributes.

concepts.title: Normal Forms
concepts.description: Schema forms (1NF–BCNF etc.) that reduce redundancy.

concepts.title: Normalization
concepts.description: Process of decomposing schemas according to normal forms.

concepts.title: Schema Design
concepts.description: Choosing tables, keys, and constraints for an application domain.
